verdict.rationale: BILL documents a record export capability covering vendors, customers, bills, invoices and AP/AR payments, and CSV import/export for accounting software. That gives a real but incomplete exit path. The export doc centers on AP/AR entities rather than Spend & Expense data such as card transactions, budgets and reimbursements, and the export file format is not stated. missing for 10: evidence of exporting all Spend & Expense data (card transactions, reimbursements, receipts, budgets), confirmation that the export uses an open format, a complete account-wide export or offboarding flow, independent corroboration.
